02 / HOW IT WORKS

Three steps to the pool

01
#1 — #777 · FREE

Claim

Free, 1 Relic per Agent ID: 48,888,800 $TALV per claim. Paid minting opens only after all 777 free claims are gone.

02
#778 — #7,777 · 0.0015 BNB

Mint

0.0015 BNB per Relic, max 5 per wallet (+1 quota for every friend you invite who paid-mints).

03
#7,777 · AUTOMATIC

Pool Opens

The same transaction pairs 8.61 BNB (82% of the 10.5 BNB total genesis funds) with $TALV on PancakeSwap V2 and burns the LP. After that, the price ladder opens for everyone.

Genesis funds: 82% liquidity · 10% for the top 100 inviters · 8% treasury. Read the whitepaper →

04 / AGENT MINT

Mint through your AI Agent

Don't want to click manually? Build the prompt below, paste it into your Binance Agent, and let the Agent mint for you.

How to mint via Agent

1

Enter your Agent's wallet address in the field next to this.

2

Copy the auto-generated prompt — it already includes the amount, max price, and rules.

3

Paste it into your AI Agent and confirm. The Agent mints max 5 Relics per wallet, 0.0015 BNB per Relic.

4

Check the result — the Relic NFT + $TALV land in the same wallet.

A Talvio Relic is a genesis-edition 16-bit pixel art NFT. Every Relic you mint gives you a 1/1 NFT plus a $TALV allocation based on the mint phase — free, paid, or ladder.
The first 777 minters. One Agent ID can claim only 1 free Relic from #1–#777, and that claim counts toward the max 5 per wallet limit.
A maximum of 5 Relics per wallet during genesis. Each valid invite (a friend paid-mints naming you as inviter) adds +1 quota.
Automatically in the same transaction when Relic #7,777 is minted. The pool on PancakeSwap V2 goes live immediately and its LP tokens are burned, so the liquidity can never be pulled by anyone.
Yes. Use the prompt generator in the Agent Mint section: enter your wallet address, copy the prompt, and paste it into your Binance Agent. The Agent still follows the max 5 limit and the per-Relic price.

Talvio was born from a simple idea: the old meme era is over — what endures are artifacts. That's why Talvio takes no one's old mascot. Every Relic is drawn as a 16-bit pixel art sprite: Owl the first guardian, the sly Fox, Deer the light-bringer, and the sovereign Raven with its golden crown.

Its genesis is also fair from the contract's first line: the first 777 Relics are free for the first 777 Agent ID holders, the same paid price for everyone, and a pool that opens itself at the final Relic — no secret buttons, no hidden team allocation. What you read in the whitepaper is exactly what the contract executes.
